placements.why: The document's content is entirely about calibration work — calibrating an instrument at a precise frequency, verifying against reference plates, and recording the settled calibration decisions. This names an organizational category for calibration activities that future envelopes will continue to feed, and nothing in the existing (empty) strata covers it.
placements.title: Calibration work as a tracked organizational category
placements.frame: What calibration activities and verification practices does the organization track?

placements.why: src-1 asserts a completed calibration of the Kestrelwood spectrograph at 88.4 MHz and src-2 grounds that assertion by citing verification against June reference plates and confirming stability across the full observing band. Together they form a thematic container for instrument calibration claims and their evidential grounding — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
placements.title: Instrument calibration verified against reference standards
placements.frame: What instrument is being calibrated, at what specification, and against what reference standard is the calibration verified?

placements.why: src-3 through src-5 perform the recording of settled calibration decisions: the 'Key decisions:' header ratifies what follows as decided, and the two parallel label-value bullets record the instrument and calibration specification as settled items with a verification basis. This is a thematic container for how calibration decisions get formally recorded for others to act on — a subject distinct from the calibration claim itself.
placements.title: Settled calibration decisions recorded as ratified items
placements.frame: What settled calibration choices are being recorded as decisions for others to act on, and what verification basis is cited?
